title: Is anyone’s school outside?
content: Parts of mine are indoor, but a majority are outside. Big standalone buildings for the most part. Part of the school resembles my Elementary school, so I assume that’s a subjective bit of the landscape, but there is a long corridor with an overhang that leads you through the main part of the campus. Does this sound familiar to anyone? The corridor has stairs as well. I can’t tell if this is because I grew up in Southern California and none of our campuses had indoor hallways. Just stand alones and trailers. Would love to hear what your school looks like
